chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: What he would like to record: his own group and arrangers
summary: He would choose his own players, tunes and arrangers and want the arranger to weigh his suggestions.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: But you have the feeling that there would be things that you would like to do on records that you haven't done.
Yes, there's quite a few things that I would like to do.
Somewhat your own group and your own selection of things...

My own pick of guys to play with and my own numbers that I would like to play. And I'd like to get my own arrangers that I'd like to arrange for the tunes, and would take some suggestions from me about it, too -- not just him. I would want for him to take my suggestions and then weigh them against his. You dig? That way we got something going.
That's not always the case, I gather.
No, it isn't. No, it isn't. It's like they say, you can't think of everything. Can't no one. And two heads is better than one -- even if one's a cabbage-head.
